description:
A language-learning diary app that helps you study a foreign language by writing your daily journal in it — Blossom.
Write in 50+ languages including English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean and more, and improve your foreign-language skills every day.

Write as much as you can in the foreign-languages. The AI assistant provides real-time corrections with perfect grammar.
Feeling hesitant to start writing in a foreign language? It’s perfectly fine to mix in your native language. The AI engine automatically translates it into natural, context-appropriate foreign-language sentences.

Even rough drafts are polished smoothly, the “Blossom Editor” helps you write in any language with ease.
Hundreds of thousands of foreign-language journal entries are updated daily on Blossom.

Blossom is the world’s first and largest AI language-learning platform that integrates journaling with AI, allowing daily diary writing to naturally turn into language learning.
With just one sentence a day, you can build a habit that covers all core language skills — writing, speaking, listening, and reading.

With a single global journal written together with AI each day, you get vocabulary study, shadowing, AI tutor conversations, and more. Every language learning feature made possible through journaling.

Join global Blossom users and record and share your daily life in a foreign language.

✨ AI Tools
• Blossom AI: Ask the AI anything about language learning.
• Blossom Editor: An AI-powered writing editor with real-time feedback and grammar correction.

🎯 Learning Features
• Diary Voca: Automatically creates vocabulary lists from your journal and helps you learn words and sentences through fun games.
• Diary Speak: Improve listening and pronunciation through shadowing practice using your own journal.
• Diary Inspector: Continue daily learning with correction history and follow-up questions.
• Proofreading: Skilled tutors provide professional corrections within 24 hours.
• Level Test: Track your proficiency level based on your journal entries.

🌍 Global Community
• Shared Diaries: Decorate your journal with stickers and share your daily life with global friends around the world.
• Language Exchange: Chat with global users in real-time and make foreign friends naturally.
• Blossom Points: Earn points through community activities and exchange them for real cash.
• Blossom World Travel: Explore new cultures and everyday lives through journals written by users worldwide.

🪄 Utility / Tools
• Blossom Translate: A brand new translator that supports “AI agentic communication” for travel, customer support, and conversations with foreign friends.
• Blossom Diary: You can use Blossom like a regular diary by setting learning language to your native language. (All decoration and community features remain available!)

🌐 Learning Languages
English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Malay, Khmer, Burmese, Turkish, Kazakh, Russian, Ukrainian, Mongolian, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Arabic, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Greek, Romanian, Hungarian, Czech, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Bulgarian, Croatian, Slovak, Slovenian, Lithuanian, Latvian, Estonian, Icelandic, Irish, Maltese, Luxembourgish, Serbian, Catalan, Albanian, Belarusian, Bosnian, Galician, Macedonian, Basque

🌸 Blossom
Blossom (Blossom Diary) began as an English Diary and has grown into the world’s first and largest platform that integrates journaling and language learning through AI.
